_template: FIND-106 template_version 1.1.0, docs_verified 2026-09-17 (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks). WIRE-10: one-shot via `vanta-cli mcp-call` (no pwsh). Copy to <project>/.cursor/hooks.json (runs from project root). DB: replace <DB_PATH>; vanta-cli must be on PATH. Secrets: session env only. Hook input arrives on stdin as JSON; {{prompt}} splices the verbatim prompt text (mcp-call resolves it, jq not needed).

preCompact.command: echo VantaDB save-state: persist open turns via thread_send and/or scene_write before compaction.

stop.command: echo VantaDB auto-capture: persist this turn via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns curated via inbox, never auto-promote.

_policy.sessionStart: memory_recall scope=agent top_k=5 -> additionalContext; empty injects NOTHING
_policy.beforeSubmitPrompt: memory_recall query=<verbatim user text> scope=agent top_k=5
_policy.stop: auto-capture via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns via inbox, never auto-promote

_scripts: No wrapper scripts needed: recall hooks invoke `vanta-cli mcp-call` one-shot (same binary the installer puts in ~/.vanta/bin); save-state hooks print a static reminder the agent acts on. Exit 0 = use output; mcp-call exit 2 = tool error (fail-loud, never silent); other non-zero = fail-open (Cursor default).
